facts.business: The Company operates on an asset-light aggregator model, procuring travel and event-related services from third-party vendors and delivering consolidated solutions to clients including MICE packages, hotel bookings, ticketing, visa support, and corporate travel solutions.

segments.name: Tour Package and other allied services

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management expects the MICE and hospitality businesses to benefit from India's economic momentum, policy initiatives in tourism, expansion of India as a global business hub, rising middle-class and premium consumer base, government investment in tourism infrastructure, adoption of hybrid and digital event formats, and cross-border opportunities from stronger trade and investment flows.

key_risks: Reliance on vendor networks for part of service delivery
Competitive intensity from organised and unorganised players
Rising input costs in travel and hospitality
facts.related_party_note: Statement of significant related party transactions (as defined by the audit committee), submitted by management, is reviewed by the Audit Committee.
